name: Pitti Engineering Ltd
title: Pitti Engineering Ltd-$ - 513519 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Pitti announces INR290 crore casting capex (capacity to 36,000 t, more than doubling) while FY26 utilisation was only 71% for casting and Q4 export shipments slipped about INR20 crore, so supply is expanding ahead of demand.

utilisation.quote: utilization levels improved to 76% for sheet metal, 81% for machining and 71% for casting

capex.quote: we are announcing a new capex program to further expand our capacities and address growing demand

triggers.label: Casting utilisation FY26 71%
triggers.quote: utilization levels improved to 76% for sheet metal, 81% for machining and 71% for casting

triggers.label: Net working capital release INR125 cr
triggers.quote: We expect INR125 crores release from working capital

triggers.label: Q4 export shortfall ~INR20 cr
triggers.quote: around about INR20-odd crores of sales have not taken place

triggers.label: FY27 volume target 78k t lamination
triggers.quote: we have targeted 78,000 tons of sales

guidance.quote: we have targeted 78,000 tons of sales
we are targeting around about 16,000 tons of sales
This should in current commodity price terms translate into roughly INR2,300 crores of top line

guidance.metric: Net debt FY28 without further lamination capex
guidance.quote: I would estimate that your net debt should be down to about INR250-odd crores
The facility is expected to be commissioned by Q1 FY30

prior_guidance_check.metric: Inventory target INR300 crore by FY29
prior_guidance_check.quote: We see the inventory levels maintaining at around INR390 crores, INR400 crores level going forward

red_flags.label: Q4 export revenue degrowth and ~INR20 cr sales slipped
red_flags.quote: around about INR20-odd crores of sales have not taken place

red_flags.label: Payables fell, inventory held at INR400 cr
red_flags.quote: our days payable have gone down

red_flags.label: Net debt ~INR570 cr with new debt-funded capex
red_flags.quote: the remaining is going to be funded through net debt

evasions.quote: That would be a little difficult for me to predict
So I don't want to comment.
